boundary.resolution: Linked cartridge-source forms, module linkage and installed ordinary-name environment; separate BIOS runtime compiler and shell are boundaries, not equivalent language/load contracts.

registers.resolution: No new mapped registerfile. Literal headers/imports/exports, source forms and installed-name inventory are specified; CPU/Memory own canonical instruction and address interfaces.

datapath.resolution: Lexical forms and binding, static dependency inclusion and eager startup, retained ordinary exports versus compile-time namespaces/static targets, ordinary global bank versus runtime library Tables. Numeric headers are cached once and the body-visible counter is tested/updated; generic headers adjust to a cached three-value tuple, call with two arguments, request visible-variable-count results and stop only on nil.

visibility.resolution: Dependency initialization before dependents and entry, export completion distinct from nil/false, shared ordinary export mutation and current-global lookup versus lexical caller locals; static namespaces are not allocated runtime Tables. The top-level local-function <init> marker creates a closure but is not an automatic normal-startup call; non-entry participants must be scheduled modules. Generic control is copied before the body independently of subsequent visible-local rebinding; shared cached references are not deep snapshots.

timing.resolution: Startup ordering is defined, not a fixed total startup/frame/cycle budget. Canonical CPU costs and Memory section startup remain referenced; the observation endpoint is not a latency specification.

interrupts.resolution: halt_until_irq is a dedicated source statement; CPU/IRQ own masks, pending state, acceptance and wake behavior. No invented BIOS-call or module IRQ contract.

faults.resolution: Finite lexer/parser/compiler rejections for source spellings, binding, imports, export/static restrictions and duplicate/cyclic modules. Runtime argument/access/fault contracts stay canonical; load wrapper protection is not generalized to compile_syntax. Independently checked current-call/out-of-context varargs, function-wide labels and jump-only scope crossing, numeric-loop cached values/body mutation/explicit zero step. Conflicting repeat-local owners are not reconciled into a language guarantee.
open: LS01: the binder keeps repeat-body locals visible through until, but the compiler removes their bindings before lowering the condition. An ordinary owned-global probe prints one pass rather than the lexical three-pass contrast. Current software is recorded separately; intended repeat-local visibility remains unresolved.

reset.resolution: Normal BIOS installation, fresh system reboot bank clearing and EXEC non-clearing are distinct. No per-image private environment, arbitrary reset/lifetime, heap reset or module-reload promise.

programming.resolution: Original six-file modules/global program plus two separate complete numeric-loop and generic-iterator cartridges. Numeric continuation has sixteen retained assertions and six separate ordinary diagnostics; iterator continuation has ten retained assertions and three separate ordinary diagnostics. Actual-owner source audits and literal reconstruction checks, a source-blind public-reader reconstruction with both findings closed, and actual 27-page DRAFT visual review pass separately. Final three changed pages re-viewed; other24 full rasters identical. LS01 stays open, not waived by these finite passes.
